frozen_design_preserved: Demonstration subsets, training seeds, batch size, 6000 updates, final-checkpoint selection, and evaluation seed bank are unchanged.

metadata_replay.reason: Original qpos logging was overwritten by unseeded SAME_STEP autoresets after an episode ended.
metadata_replay.change: Record qpos only at explicitly seeded resets, then replay each final checkpoint on the same 50 cases and compare outcomes.
metadata_replay.replay_variation_handling: Exact repeatability was not achieved in every case. Preserve the first formal evaluation as primary; report all replay differences separately. Reconstructed initial poses are labelled as replay-derived, not original observations.
metadata_replay.review: The upstream evaluator enables cuDNN benchmark; strict determinism was not enforced. The exact numerical source of observed differences has not been fully isolated. No further outcome-dependent reruns are performed.

infrastructure_replacement.reason: Measured update speed near 0.20 seconds rather than 0.09 seconds projected to exceed the original hard runtime limit.
infrastructure_replacement.restart: Fresh initialization with identical seed and unchanged training/evaluation settings; no model was selected using outcome scores.

concurrency: Original training: up to 5 GPUs. Recovery: 1 replacement training GPU plus up to 4 metadata-audit GPUs.
